source: English translation extracted and cleaned from the user-supplied bilingual Hizbul-Azam PDF

items.text: Guide us to the path of peace, release us from darkness to light, save us from obscene practices whether open or hidden. Bless us in our ears, our eyes, our hearts, our wives and our children and accept our repentance
Verily You are Most Forgiving Most Merciful
Make us thankful to You for Your favours that we may praise You for it, make us worthy of Your favours and please complete Your bounty upon us

33. O Allah, grant us Your fear in such a way that it becomes a barrier between us and committing sins. Make us obedient to You in such a way that it will take us to Jannah. Bless us with such conviction that enables us to face worldly calamities with ease. Let us enjoy the benefits of our ears, our eyes and bodily strength as long as You keep us alive and continue their goodness after our death
Take revenge on those who have been cruel to us and help us against those who oppress us and let not any calamity spoil our Imaan
Let not this worldly life become our main objective nor the limit of our knowledge
And do not put us under the control of such people who will have no pity on us
34. O Allah, increase (Your grace) for us and do not decrease it. Grant us honour and do not disgrace us, Give us and do not deprive us, grant us preference and let not others be preferred over us
Allow us to be pleased with You and You be pleased with us
35. O Allah, inspire my heart with thoughts that will be good for my guidance and save me from the evil of my base desires

36. O Allah, I beg of You the ability to perform good deeds and to abstain from evil deeds. (I beg of You the ability) to love the poor. Forgive me and have mercy on me. (O Allah) when You intend to test a nation then take me away from this world without being tested. O Allah, I beg of You to grant me Your love and the love of those who love You, as well as those deeds that will make me acquire Your love
37. O Allah, make Your love more beloved to me than myself, my family and cool water

38. O Allah, grant me Your love as well as the love of those people whose love will be beneficial to me by You. O Allah, As You have blessed me with gifts that I love, so allow me to use it in avenues that You love. O Allah, Whatever You have kept away from me which I love (but are to my detriment), make them a source of freedom for me so that I may be able to fulfil all that which You love
39. O Controller of hearts, let my heart hold fast onto Your religion

40. O Allah, I beg of You to bless me with Imaan which does not waver, bounties which never terminate and the company of our beloved Nabi Muhammad in the highest stages of Jannah, the Everlasting Jannah

41. O Allah, allow me to take benefit from my knowledge, teach me what will be useful to me and increase me in knowledge. All praise is due to Allah Ta’ala under all conditions and I seek Allah’s protection from the condition of the inmates of Hell

42. O Allah, by Your knowledge of the unseen and the power which You have over Your creation, keep me alive for as long as it is in my best interest to be alive and grant me death when it is best for me. Grant me theability to fear You both in secret and in public and to speak with truth and sincerity in moments of joy and anger. I also ask for moderation in spending, both in poverty and in prosperity
And I ask for Your favours which never end. I ask You to cool my eyes with such favours that will never end

I ask You to make me submit happily to Your decrees, a comfortable life after death, the delight of seeing Your blessed countenance and the deep desire to meet You. I seek Your protection from disastrous calamities and fitnahs (tests and trials) which cause me to go astray. O Allah, beautify me with the beauty of Imaan, guide us and make us guides for others as well (to the right path)
43. O Allah, I beg of You for all good whether it comes sooner or later and whether I know of it or not
I seek Your protection from all evil whether it comes sooner or later and whether I know of it or not. O Allah, I beg of You to grant me
Jannah and all such words and deeds which will lead me to it
And I seek Your protection from the Fire of Hell and all such words and deeds which will lead me to it
I beg of You that Your decree be favourable to me and I beg You that whatever decision You have taken concerning me, let the ultimate end be favourable
44. O Allah, grant us the best possible results in all things of our life and save us from disgrace in this world and punishment in the hereafter
45. O Allah, protect me with Islam whilst standing, protect me whilst sitting and protect me whilst sleeping and do not give my enemy or a jealous person the chance to ridicule me

O Allah, I beg of You all good things the treasures of which are in Your Hands and I seek Your protection from all evil things the treasures of which are in Your Hands and I seek Your protection from the evil of all things which You have control of by its forelocks
46. O Allah, I beg of You a pure and honourable life, an easy death and a place of ultimate return (hereafter) which is free from any misery and disgrace
47. O Allah, I am weak, grant me strength in this weakness of mine in seeking Your pleasure
Lead me towards good by my forelock and make Islam the source of greatest happiness for me. O Allah, verily I am weak, grant me strength
I am disgraced, so please grant me respect and I am poor, so please grant me sustenance

1. O Allah, I ask of You the best of whatever can be asked, the best dua, true success, good deeds, the best reward, the best life and an excellent death. Grant me firmness (in Deen), cause my good actions to outweigh my evil ones, strengthen my Imaan, exalt me, accept my salaah and forgive my sins
I beg You for a lofty position in Jannah. Aameen

O Allah, I beg of You to bless me with goodness at the beginning, and at the end grant me the perfection of all virtuous deeds, the sum and substance of virtue and, the first and last and outer and inner ingredients of virtue and I beg of You for a lofty position in Jannah. Aameen
O Allah, save me from the fire of Hell and grant me Your forgiveness during the night and the day and bless me with a good home in Jannah
Aameen . O Allah, I beg of You for freedom from the Fire of Hell

Safely and (I beg You) to grant me a safe entry into Jannah. O Allah, I beg of You good conduct as well as virtuous actions, goodness in all that which is hidden and what is apparent (in my deeds) and (I beg You) for a lofty position in Jannah. Aameen . O Allah, I beg of You to raise my reputation, free me from the burden of sins, correct my affairs, purify my heart, protect the chastity of my private parts, illuminate my grave, forgive my sins and I beg You for a lofty position in Jannah. Aameen . O Allah, I beg of You to bless me in my hearing, my seeing, my soul, my physical body, my character, my family, my wealth, in my life and death and in my actions
O Allah, accept my good deeds, and I beg You for a lofty position in Jannah. Aameen
2. O Allah, make my rizq (sustenance) the most abundant during my old age and at the last portion of my life
3. O The One whom eyes cannot see, minds cannot fully comprehend, admirers cannot praise sufficiently, One who situations do not affect him,

One who does not fear the changing times , Who fully knows the weight of mountains, the measure of the seas, the number of droplets of rain, the number of leaves on the trees, the number of things over which the night throws its darkness and the day sheds its light,

The One from Whom one heaven cannot hide the other heaven nor can one layer of earth hide the other nor are the contents at the bottom of the oceans hidden from Him nor is the inner substance of the mountains hidden from Him. (O Allah) make the last part of my life the best part, my last action the best one and the best day in my life the day I meet with You. (O Allah)
4. O The Master of Islam and The Master of the followers of Islam, keep me firm on Islam until
I meet You
5. O Allah, I beg of You for prosperity for myself and for my family members
6. O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me and admit me into Jannah
7. O Allah, make me patient and make me be grateful to You
Make me look small in my eyes but great in the eyes of others
references: 6. Mu’jamul Kabeer # 667 ; 7. Majma’uz Zawaaid # 181 ; 8. Musnad Ahmad # 2616

items.text: 8. O Allah, I beg of You to bless me with beneficial knowledge, deeds that are accepted, and pure, well-earned sustenance
9. O Allah, I seek Your forgiveness for my sins and I beg You to guide me
To the ways of achieving success in my efforts. I seek refuge in You from the evil of my carnal desires and I repent before You. Please accept my repentance as You are indeed my Rabb
O Allah, incline my heart towards You, grant me contentment of the heart and grant me barakah in my sustenance given by You to me. Accept my good deeds as You are indeed my Rabb
10. O The One who has publicised my good actions but concealed my sins
O The One who does not penalise me for every fault nor does he remove the curtain, (exposing my faults)
O, The Giver of limitless forgiveness, The Most Tolerant, The One with everlasting forgiveness, The One with both hands stretched out to dispense mercy
O You who is aware of even a whisper, Who is the last resort for every complaint,
Who is extremely generous in forgiving sins, Extremely Compassionate, Who initiates
His Grace even before it is merited. O our Rabb, our Master, our protector The Sole purpose of the yearning of our hearts, we beg You, O Allah, do not roast our bodies in the Fire
11. O Allah, I beg of You Your Grace and Your Mercy as none possesses it besides You
12. O Allah, You have given me a good physical form. So bless me with good manners as well
references: 11. Mu’jamul Kabeer # 10379 ; 12. Musnad Ahmad # 3813 ; 13. Musnad Ahmad # 26145

items.text: 13. O My Rabb, forgive me, have mercy on me, guide me to the straight path
14. O Allah, the Rabb of Nabi Muhammad , forgive my sins, quench the fire (of anger) in my heart, save me from tests that will lead me astray as long as You keep me alive
15. O Allah, grant me pure sustenance and engage me in good actions
16. O Allah, I beg You to please bless me with good though it is without any preceding means and
I seek Your protection from sudden calamities
17. O Allah, Your name is As-Salaam (The Giver of Peace) and peace comes only from You and to You does return. I beg of You, O Majestic
17. Majma’uz Zawaaid # and Benevolent One that You accept all our duas,
You fulfil our desires and You make us independent from
Your creatures who have no need towards us
18. O Allah, save me from Your punishment on the Day You will resurrect Your servants
19. O Allah, You choose for me what is best for me and then grant it to me

20. It is reported in authentic Ahaadith that Rasulullah used to recite the following dua very often: : O Allah, give us the good of this world and the good of the hereafter and save us from the punishment of Hell
May the blessings of the name of Allah descend on me, my wealth and my Deen. O Allah, make me pleased with Your decree and grant me barakah (blessings) in whatever You have decreed for me so that
I do not desire to hasten that which You have delayed or delay what
You have hastened
22. O Allah, There is no life but the life of the hereafter
23. O Allah, allow me to live as a humble person, cause me to die as a humble person and raise me (on the Day of Judgement) in the company of the humble
24. O Allah, make me from those who when they do good deeds they rejoice and when they do wrong they ask for forgiveness

25. O Allah, I beg of You Your special mercy by which You would guide my heart, consolidate my affairs, straighten out for me my muddled dealings, improve my religious life, settle my debts, protect my interests in my absence, promote my outer matters, illuminate my face, purify my actions (from pride), inspire my heart with righteousness, divert my passions (to desirable things) and save me from all evil. O Allah, bless me with
Imaan that will never terminate, such yaqeen (firm conviction) after which there is no possibility of disbelief

And (bless me with) rahmat (mercy) through which I can attain Your special favours in this world and the hereafter. O Allah, I beg of You to bless me with success in the decisions You have passed in my favour, the hospitality afforded to the martyrs, happiness bestowed upon the fortunate, the company of the Ambiyaa (messengers) and victory over the enemies
Verily, You hear all duas. O Allah, I place before You
